summary: You pick the Cells, Molecules & Organisms or the Ecology/Evolution subplan, each with its own required courses (including its ethics course); CMOB adds two committee-approved courses you move in and the lab rotations, Eco/Evo the first-year paper and presentation. The audit checks BIO 290 for each of your two teaching quarters plus BIO 296, and 135 graduate units; no course has to be letter graded unless its description says so. The mentored teaching, the 3.0 GPA the university requires, committee meetings, the qualifying exam and candidacy, the oral exam, the dissertation and a first-author manuscript are checked by hand.

c6xjSQgh.why: "Ecology/Evolution enroll in MED 255. Cells, Molecules, & Organisms enroll in BIO 312." Each subplan already requires its course (BIO 312 in the CMOB courses, MED 255 in the Eco/Evo required courses), so this restates it.

D0mz9uxa.why: "BIO 290 is to be taken concurrently with each quarter of required teaching. BIO 296 is to be taken concurrently with the first quarter of required teaching." and "Each student must complete 2 quarters of a Mentored Teaching Experience (MTE)": two enrollments in BIO 290 and one in BIO 296.

2t00FvEE.why: "Each student must complete 2 quarters of a Mentored Teaching Experience (MTE) by Autumn Quarter of the third year. At least one course at the introductory/foundational level (BIO 40s and 80s level courses...)" A requirement, not an overview; which courses were taught is checked by a person.

patch.name: Two quarters of Mentored Teaching Experience by Autumn of the third year
